S03 — S03 Empirical quality/latency/VRAM model cards
Fourteen future hostile cases, NOT EXECUTED
M07 does not lower quality targets

facets.title: Composite model package identity
facets.boundary: A weight-only digest cannot prove tokenizer, adapter or code closure.

facets.title: Exact task and evaluation fixtures
facets.boundary: Different task populations or leaked data cannot be compared as equal.

facets.title: M07 original hardware and runtime
facets.boundary: A copied device name is not exact source-qualified hardware, driver, topology or runtime evidence.

facets.title: M08 bounded protocol and admission
facets.boundary: A designed protocol does not constitute authorized benchmark execution.

facets.title: Original samples with units and timing
facets.boundary: Reported latency or VRAM without raw provenance cannot establish measurement.

facets.title: Contamination, abort and uncertainty
facets.boundary: Unknown telemetry or interruption must not become valid confidence.

facets.title: Independent M01 quality evaluation
facets.boundary: A faster result cannot bypass M01 fatal defects, required human review or the accepted M02 master.

facets.title: Freshness, invalidation and tenant rights
facets.boundary: An expired card or a license label cannot establish current tenant rights.

alternatives.title: Vendor model card notes
alternatives.tradeoffs: Simple discovery but lacks immutable package closure, original samples, exact M07 host/protocol and independently qualified legal or owner scope.

alternatives.title: Typed per-task evidence table
alternatives.tradeoffs: Typed missing-value semantics help comparison, but a table row cannot prove authentic sample provenance, contamination status or valid evaluator rights.

alternatives.title: Versioned source-qualified evidence graph
alternatives.tradeoffs: Exact model/task/M07/M08/M01 lineage and invalidation edges are expressive, but need real qualified schema owners, revocation handling and tenant redaction.

alternatives.title: Future authenticated at-use measurement receipt
alternatives.tradeoffs: A future current scoped owner receipt could bind real measurements, but requires independently verified issuer, representative M08 evidence and valid rights.

questions.question: Which complete immutable composite package fingerprint must bind every future card and its dependent tokenizer and adapter revisions?
Which exact task, input-output constraints and sampling population make future quality and latency records representative?
Which fixture provenance, consent and leakage evidence prevents overstating generalization from an unqualified sample set?
What exact M07 device, topology, driver and runtime snapshot must accompany each future model-specific benchmark record?
What independent M08 owner admission and bounded protocol receipt is needed before any future GPU or provider benchmark?
Which declared metrics disambiguate cold start, warm latency, throughput, per-frame timing and peak VRAM without numerical shortcuts?
Which clock, duration, units, raw sample count, warmup and aggregation rules must be preserved in each future model card?
How can UNKNOWN telemetry, interference, cancellation and thermal abort retain explicit non-valid uncertainty and context?
Which allocation, shared memory, peak residency and OOM evidence remains separate from authority for an M09 resource lease?
Which versioned M01 evaluator, fidelity class, fatal defect checks and human review preserve independent final quality authority?
What sample size, population bias and uncertainty provenance must precede any future reliability or confidence assertion?
Which prompt, fixture, seed and compiler-option provenance is required without admitting M13/M16 provider code execution?
How are multimodal codecs, timestamps, spatial crops, audio persona and 3D topology matched before an equivalence claim?
When are two real model-card observations incomparable because package, M07 runtime, protocol or population differs?
Which calibration, time-to-live, signed lineage, revocation and invalidation edges govern any future released card?
Which tenant-scoped model, dataset, performer and derivative rights require separate M18/M53/M54 owner evidence?
How must immutable M02 master status and M01 hard quality veto remain separate from a fast preview performance figure?
Which qualified future M10/M15 advisor can see tentative data without choosing rankings or actual placement and dispatch?
How should warm caches, residency, batching and compilation hints be distinguished from live M09 grant and M11 ACK?
What independent actual model-card owner issuer, authenticated scope, expiry and refresh proof must precede any real evidence label?

negativeScenarios.trigger: Changed weight shards share the old label while tokenizer and adapter revisions differ from the recorded evidence.
A vendor image-quality claim is copied from another task population with different input crops and prompts.
A leaked benchmark fixture is reused as independent evaluation evidence despite training population overlap.
A benchmark card drops its exact M07 driver and runtime binding while asserting current hardware equivalence.
A protocol draft is marked as a completed authorized GPU test without actual M08 admission or raw results.
Cold-start latency is substituted for warm-cache throughput and misrepresented as end-to-end task latency.
Synthetic timing values are aggregated into a precise quantile without actual raw samples or clock provenance.
Interrupted and thermally contaminated runs with unknown telemetry are marked fully valid and comparable.
A device-memory allocation number is treated as a live complete M09 lease and safe multi-model placement.
High reported throughput bypasses an unresolved fatal M01 fidelity defect and missing actual human review.
A tiny biased synthetic population is assigned unjustified confidence as a production-wide reliability fact.
An untrusted compiled provider hint is mistaken for an actual measured M13/M16 backend execution receipt.
A video-plus-audio task is compared with a text-only fixture and different temporal or spatial contracts.
Latency and VRAM winners are selected across non-equivalent GPUs, runtime revisions and evaluation tasks.
Revoked sources and expired calibration remain marked current and drive future model-card publication.
A foreign tenant publishes protected fixture data using a stale source permission and a copied model card.
